Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1305
Claimant:
Jon Johnson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
March 1, 2024
Claim opened after a side impact at an intersection was reported by the claimant, who is not represented by an
attorney. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and states that the other vehicle entered the intersection while the
claimant had the right of way.
March 7, 2024
Police report on file confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The driver of the claimant's
vehicle lives with the policyholder and is listed as a covered household member under the policy.
March 12, 2024
Photos from the scene confirm the general position of both veihcles and the point of contact on the driver's side. No
independent witnesses have been identified, so the account rests on the parties and the police documentation.
March 18, 2024
Damage to the vehcile is mostly in line with the described impact. A few old scratches near the rear quarter panel
may predate this crash and are being noted separately for the estimate.
June 4, 2024
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage start date. Underwriting records were reviewed
and show no prior claims on the vehicle.
July 24, 2024
The claimant later provided a few additional details about the seating position and the moment of impact, but the core
account has remained the same across each staetment taken so far.
August 4, 2024
The reported shoulder injury matches the kind and force expected from a side impact of this type. Medical records
show a usual course of treatment that tapered off as the claimant improved.
August 13, 2024
Medical history shows the claimant was treated for the same body area within the last two years. That prior condition
appears to add to the current complaints, and the medical reviewer is weighing its contribution separately from the
crash-related injury.
August 16, 2024
Overall the injury and vehicle damage fit the reported collision, with the prior shoulder condition and older scratches
flagged for separate handling. The file is ready for the next settlement review step.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
